memo: New scope test on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except the CPU edits; our fragment re-rank on the blind molecules kept (e3fg05c-1 = 0.432). Results so far: our neutral-loss evidence on every molecule with a seen loss (28 of 400) = 0.434 (best); adding the 17 diagnostic product ions (164 molecules, most of them GLACIER-scored) = 0.424; the fragment signal on GLACIER-scored molecules = 0.427. Pattern: our evidence helps where the forward models are blind and hurts on top of GLACIER. This build applies the loss + ion evidence only on the molecules neither GLACIER nor ICEBERG scored (nlcov=blind). Hypothesis: the ions are informative where nothing else orders the isomers -> LB >= 0.434.
message: e3fg05nlib05c-1: E006 0.440 base (CPU) + our fragment re-rank + our neutral-loss and ion evidence, both only where ICEBERG and GLACIER are blind. Hypothesis: LB >= 0.434
